title: Google signs deal for 500 MW of Kairos Power small reactors by 2035

sources.quote: Alameda, CA – October 14, 2024 – Kairos Power and Google have signed a Master Plant Development Agreement, creating a path to deploy a U.S. fleet of advanced nuclear power projects totaling 500 MW by 2035.

explain: Google agreed to buy power from a fleet of Kairos Power molten-salt reactors totaling 500 MW, with the first by 2030 and the rest by 2035, under power purchase agreements. Prices not disclosed. Plants: future Kairos reactors near Google data centers; the first is Hermes 2 in Oak Ridge, Tennessee.
